question.problem: Find the roots of the polynomial $p(w)=8{w}^{3}-20{w}^{2}-12w.$
question.worked_solution:
To find the roots of the polynomial, we must solve the equation $p(w)=0,$ that is

$$
8{w}^{3}-20{w}^{2}-12w=0.
$$

First, notice that all of the terms of the polynomial have a common factor of $4w.$ We can factor out the $4w$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}4w(2{w}^{2}-5w-3) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we factor the expression $2{w}^{2}-5w-3$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}4w(2{w}^{2}-5w-3) & =0 \\ 4w(2w+1)(w-3) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, by applying the zero product rule, the solutions are $w=0,$ $w=-\frac{1}{2},$ and $w=3.$
